title: Circuit Encoding and Satisfiability
statement: For a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables, its encoding as a bit string belongs to the language of encodings of satisfiable circuit trees if and only if the circuit tree is satisfiable.
hypotheses_covered: A circuit tree on some natural number $n$ of variables
